description: This file defines utility functions for managing WriteAheadLog instances in Spark Streaming, including creation, configuration, and class instantiation logic.

methods.name: enableReceiverLog
methods.description: Checks if receiver logging is enabled based on SparkConf.

methods.name: getRollingIntervalSecs
methods.description: Retrieves the rolling interval seconds for WAL based on configuration and context (driver or receiver).

methods.name: getMaxFailures
methods.description: Retrieves the maximum number of failures allowed for WAL based on configuration and context.

methods.name: isBatchingEnabled
methods.description: Determines if batching is enabled for WAL based on configuration and context.

methods.name: getBatchingTimeout
methods.description: Gets the batching timeout duration for BatchedWriteAheadLog.

methods.name: shouldCloseFileAfterWrite
methods.description: Checks if WAL files should be closed after each write based on configuration and context.

methods.name: createLogForDriver
methods.description: Creates a WriteAheadLog instance for the driver, considering custom class configuration.

methods.name: createLogForReceiver
methods.description: Creates a WriteAheadLog instance for the receiver, considering custom class configuration.

methods.name: createLog
methods.description: Internal method to instantiate a WriteAheadLog based on configuration, class name, and context.

methods.name: instantiateClass
methods.description: Instantiates a WriteAheadLog class, trying constructor with SparkConf or default constructor.
